title: Vesper and the Cipher
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Ivo Whitlock, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
